description: Authoritative approved live-trading window for the graded DCA task (ce16ba6b). Weekdays in [start_date, end_date] inclusive are the approved_test_dates; outside them run_once's date gate blocks all execution. Sourced from scheduled_tasks.json trigger_window. decision_time_et aligns the strategy's decision anchor with ce16ba6b's authoritative 3:30 PM ET (15:30) run time (scheduled_tasks.json marks the 3:45 display as stale); change it if the live run time changes. end_date extended 2026-07-26 from 2026-08-28 to 2026-10-30 to avoid the approved-window hard stop while Phase 2's real market calendar is pending (PRODUCTION_READINESS.md). Deliberately stops the Friday before the 2026-11-01 EDT->EST transition: the three live tasks' cron schedules in config/scheduled_tasks.json (and the external trigger gate) are fixed-UTC/EDT-only, so extending past the DST change would fire live trades an hour off in ET terms (or reject them outright) until that external scheduler config is made DST-aware. Extend again (or replace this gate) before the new end_date, and only past 2026-10-30 once the external cron/trigger gate has been confirmed or updated for EST.
